requirementMap: Auto peer review reports: flags proteomics-specific claims that need reviewer attention.
Claims versus evidence alignment: checks peptide/protein FDR, protein inference, PTM localization, and biomarker validation.
Reproducibility checker: verifies raw files, workflow files, environment locks, parameter manifests, and result checksums.
Adaptive domain template: specializes the assistant for LC-MS/MS, DIA, TMT, PTM, and biomarker manuscripts.

results.title: DIA-PASEF plasma biomarker validation
actions: Proceed to reviewer-ready peer-review packet with proteomics evidence attached.

results.title: Discovery proteomics with loose FDR and weak inference

findings.message: Peptide-level FDR exceeds the standard 1% review threshold.
findings.action: Tighten peptide-spectrum match filtering or qualify affected claims.

findings.message: Protein-level FDR exceeds the standard 1% review threshold.
findings.action: Recompute protein groups at 1% FDR or downgrade protein-level conclusions.

findings.message: Search packet does not document target-decoy or equivalent error control.
findings.action: Attach decoy strategy, FDR estimation method, and thresholding notes.

findings.message: Protein database version is missing from the manuscript packet.
findings.action: Record UniProt/refseq database version and contaminant database handling.

findings.message: Mass tolerances are broad enough to require extra false-discovery justification.
findings.action: Explain instrument mode and validate tolerance choices against decoy performance.

findings.message: Quantification packet does not include a usable normalization strategy.
findings.action: Add normalization method and show effect on key protein estimates.

findings.message: Batch randomization or adjustment evidence is incomplete.
findings.action: Provide batch design, bridge samples, and adjusted sensitivity analysis.

findings.message: QC coefficient of variation is above the 20% review target.
findings.action: Add QC trend plots and exclude unstable features or batches.

findings.message: Feature missingness is high enough to threaten claim stability.
findings.action: Report missingness handling and run sensitivity analysis for key claims.

findings.message: Protein-level claim relies on weak unique-peptide or inference evidence.
findings.action: Require at least two unique peptides per claimed protein or qualify protein-group ambiguity.

findings.message: Biomarker claim lacks independent validation cohort evidence.
findings.action: Mark the finding as discovery-only or add validation cohort support.

findings.message: Biomarker claim has weak adjusted significance for reviewer-ready wording.
findings.action: Calibrate claim wording and show correction method with confidence intervals.

findings.message: Raw LC-MS/MS file count is lower than the sample manifest expects.
findings.action: Block reviewer-ready status until raw files or documented exclusions are attached.

findings.message: No public or controlled-access raw data accession is included.
findings.action: Deposit raw data in a proteomics repository or document controlled-access route.

findings.message: No executable search or quantification workflow is listed.
findings.action: Attach workflow, scripts, and execution notes for reproducibility checking.

findings.message: Environment lockfile is missing.
findings.action: Add conda, container, lockfile, or versioned workflow environment evidence.

findings.message: Parameter manifest or result checksums are incomplete.
findings.action: Attach search parameters and digest output tables for rerun comparison.
